The table is uncertain and the history is thin (one Y case), so I shade this to about 0.75. My initial estimate was 0.66, and I'm moving up to about 0.75.

C here, round 4, context Y. Signals: A=0, B=1, C=1. The prior table puts Y reliability at A 0.40, B 0.65, C 0.65. These are elicited estimates with wide intervals. History: round 3 in Y had the same profile (A0, B1, C1) with truth 1, so A missed in Y once. Our group has been underconfident; rounds 2 and 3 landed near 0.65 with truth 1. My initial estimate was 0.67. I suggest moving to about 0.75–0.80, tempered by small samples.
